article.title: The Economics of Small Decisions
article.content: People often think financial outcomes depend only on major choices, such as buying a house or changing jobs. In reality, repeated small decisions also matter. Daily spending habits, subscription management, and automatic savings can shape long-term results. Behavioral economists note that convenience strongly influences choices. When saving is easy and default, people save more. Designing better personal systems can be more effective than relying only on willpower.
article.translation: 很多人认为财务结果只取决于大决定，比如买房或换工作。实际上，反复出现的小决定同样重要。日常消费习惯、订阅管理和自动储蓄都会影响长期结果。行为经济学指出，“便利性”对选择影响很大：当储蓄机制更简单、默认开启时，人们更容易存下钱。设计更好的个人系统，往往比单纯依靠意志力更有效。
